Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained, but the case is borderline and deserves a ruling. The Latvian Academy of Culture opens, within its bachelor's degree in dramatic theatre acting, a single specialism in Physical and Object Theatre, over four years and eight semesters, designed in close cooperation with the Latvian Puppet Theatre, the national puppet house. The page was read: the word puppet appears in no specialism title. The exclusion therefore rests on the letter of the denominator, which requires a specialism in puppetry arts, and not on any absence of connection to the field, a connection the partnership makes explicit. Ruling needed for the whole series: does object theatre count as puppetry arts? If it does, Latvia moves to 1 and other countries need re-examining. For now the answer taken is no, and the upper bound stays at 1 to carry that doubt.
